summary: The diff adds a new Appointment form section on the landing page, client-side validation, and multiple navigation/CTA entry points that scroll to the form. It also introduces a WhatsApp deep-link generator using a wa.me URL with URL-encoded text. However, the diff includes multiple unrelated styling/SEO/UI changes not requested in the BuildRequest, and the WhatsApp prefill message includes emoji/formatting beyond the stated English-only text constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Unrequested broad SEO/content changes across the site (metadata, JSON-LD, expanded Ahmedabad keyword targeting, and copy edits beyond adding the appointment feature).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asks to add an appointment form + validation + an access link/button, and explicitly focuses on WhatsApp deep-linking without broader marketing/SEO rewrites.

hallucinated_features.description: Unrequested global theme/styling system changes (primary palette swaps, new service-specific color tokens, new shadow/radius utilities, and other design-system adjustments).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-85/86/87; the request is feature-focused and does not ask for a redesign.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to floating contact button sizing/spacing.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-85/86/87 and could be considered outside the appointment feature scope.
The BuildRequest non-goals explicitly exclude adding chat/automation behavior to the appointment flow; while this is “polish”, it is unrelated and unrequested work.
